claims.text: POL-NS-01 is the anchor clause on which this 4.50 was charged, and it is drafted conjunctively: limb (d) requires the trip_record to show the trip terminated by the DRIVER under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The platform's own record shows the opposite. EV-TRIP-02739 carries cancelled_by 'RIDER', cancellation_reason_code 'RIDER_CANCELLED' and status 'CANCELLED_BY_RIDER', and its only trip_cancelled event at 15:20:31 is attributed to the rider, with no driver termination anywhere in the event list. The rider's account that she cancelled and the driver did not is therefore not a contested assertion about facts - it is what the platform's own telemetry records, and limb (d) fails on the face of the record.

No artifact in this bundle records any driver-side no-show step: EV-TRIP-02739 holds no driver termination, no unreachable-rider report, no excessive-wait report and no in-app call, and EV-CHAT-02739 holds only the driver's 'im at the pickup' at 15:14:36 and the rider's own 'sorry cant make it, cancelling' at 15:18:16. The counterparty's statement that 'she cancelled' is consistent with a rider cancellation and establishes nothing on the driver-termination limb that POL-NS-01(d) requires. The precondition for charging this sum as a no-show fee is thus absent from the evidence, and the rider asks the Judge to decide on the two records rather than on either party's description of them.

POL-NS-01 provides that where any of its limbs fails the fee 'is not chargeable under this clause'. The rider's remedy is confined to the single line that was charged - the 4.50 cancellation_fee in EV-FARE-02739, that being the whole contested amount, with no waiting-time fee charged (that line reads 0.00) and no other fare component in issue. The rider does not press grounds the timings in EV-TRIP-02739 do not support: the cancellation at 15:20:31 came well after the 180 second post-match grace, and no waiting-period shortfall is alleged. The rider asks that the contested 4.50 be returned in full on the reason-code ground above, which is the whole of the relief sought.

claims.text: The trip record fixes the sequence without ambiguity: driver assigned 15:09:24, driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 15:14:06, the platform started the free waiting timer at 15:14:08, and the rider cancelled at 15:20:31 - six minutes and twenty-five seconds after the driver arrived and 385 seconds after the waiting clock began, against a free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, read with POL-NS-01(c) and the fee_schedule.resolution_rule). The driver did everything the platform asks of him before the rider pulled the trip.

The driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for one continuous qualifying run of 39 fixes lasting 382 seconds, from 15:14:06 to 15:20:28, per derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run. The derived shortfall against the minimum dwell is -202 seconds, i.e. he exceeded the 180 second free waiting period in force by more than a factor of two; the run clears even the 300 second pre-version-2 STANDARD figure, so the outcome does not depend on which figure is used.

The arrival marker is genuine, so the waiting clock runs from 15:14:06 and is not defeated by POL-NS-05. The derived dwell start offset is 0.0 seconds - the first qualifying in-geofence fix coincides with the tapped arrival - and the driver's recorded minimum distance from the pin is 0.11 m with a stationary speed reading, nowhere near POL-NS-05's 300 m or 15 km/h triggers. There is no false-arrival event to record against this driver.

The rider cancelled this trip in her own right, after the driver had arrived and after the in-geofence dwell had already run past the free waiting period. That is exactly the case POL-NS-10(g) governs: the fee stands at platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd as if the trip had been terminated by the driver for a no-show, and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout. The rider's stated ground - 'I cancelled myself, the driver did not cancel' - is therefore not a defence to the charge but the very fact that triggers it.

Independently of the no-show route, POL-NS-10(f) makes a rider's own cancellation after the grace chargeable: the cancellation came 667 seconds after accepted_at, far beyond the 180 second grace_after_match_sec, and none of the four exculpatory exceptions is on the record. The driver began navigating 8 seconds after assignment, so he had begun moving within the grace; he arrived at 15:14:06, 42 seconds after the 4-minute ETA the record shows at assignment and comfortably inside the 180 second tolerance; nothing in the chat shows the driver asking the rider to cancel; and there is no vehicle or driver mismatch.

The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04. Its limb (a) requires a message that is locating or coordinating; the rider's only message, sent at 15:18:16, reads 'sorry cant make it, cancelling' - that is an abandonment of the pickup, not coordination towards it. Limb (c) is moreover affirmatively failed, not merely undecidable: the rider's own track holds 59 fixes whose distance from the pin runs from 764.6 m to 771.3 m (mean 767.9 m), every one of them far outside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, with rider_qualifying_fix_count 0. POL-NS-11 has no application because the rider track is present and runnable.

The driver put the rider on notice and the rider read it. The driver's message 'im at the pickup' was sent at 15:14:36 and read at 15:14:56, and the rider then waited nearly four more minutes before cancelling. A rider who is at the pin and trying to be collected does not read 'im at the pickup' and respond four minutes later with a cancellation; the chat corroborates that the fee is being disputed after the fact, not that the pickup failed.

The compensation is due and nothing withholds it. POL-NS-07 applies because POL-NS-10(g) applies, and the driver's compensation resolves to SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force - the figure the fare_breakdown's own money block computes as driver_compensation. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (101) is approximately 0.02, below the 0.08 ratio; both are the fields POL-NS-07 names, and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter for the trailing-30-day figure. The ruling value is therefore DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd under POL-GEN-03.

There is no integrity defect in the money or the trace. The fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50 for this trip, so POL-NS-08(d) is satisfied and the amount is not open to challenge; payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the present state the rider asks to be left alone is a charge that is properly standing.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road in this window: EV-ADVIS-02739-01 is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0, which I disclose rather than present as clean. Its absence means no kerbside restriction, enforcement, closure or accident operated on the pickup road to disrupt the driver's wait, so POL-NS-06's limb (i) accumulation route is neither available nor needed - the driver's dwell was a single uninterrupted in-geofence run that already cleared the minimum.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this ruling concerns the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02739.

The rider is right on one point, and it does not help her. This charge cannot stand as a driver-declared no-show: POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip record to show the trip terminated by the DRIVER under RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. EV-TRIP-02739 shows cancelled_by RIDER, cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CANCELLED and status CANCELLED_BY_RIDER at 15:20:31, with no driver termination anywhere in the event list. Limb (d) therefore fails and the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01.

It is chargeable under POL-NS-10, which governs a fee triggered by the rider's own cancellation. The rider accepted at 15:09:24 and cancelled at 15:20:31, 667 seconds later - far beyond the 180-second grace_after_match_sec - so POL-NS-10(f) makes the fee stand at platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd = SGD 4.50. None of the four exceptions is on the record: the driver began navigating 8 seconds after assignment; he arrived at 15:14:06, inside 180 seconds of the 4-minute ETA shown to the rider at assignment; he never asked the rider to cancel; and there is no vehicle or driver mismatch. POL-NS-10(g) applies on top of that: EV-GPS-02739 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in one continuous qualifying run of 382 seconds, from 15:14:06 to 15:20:28, comfortably exceeding the 180-second free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02739.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The rider cancelled after the driver had performed, and the fee stands as if the trip had been terminated for a no-show.

The rider cannot be exculpated. EV-GPS-02739's rider track places her device 764.6 m to 771.3 m from the pin (mean 767.9 m) with no qualifying fix, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is affirmatively failed, and POL-NS-11 has no application where the rider track is present and runnable. There is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06: the derived shortfall is -202 seconds. The driver's 'im at the pickup' (15:14:36) was read at 15:14:56, minutes before the cancellation.

Compensation: POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force = SGD 3.60, the same figure the fare_breakdown money block computes. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 2 is below 4, and 2 divided by 101 completed_trips_30d is about 0.02, below 0.08. Lifetime counters such as prior_no_show_flags are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used as a ground.

Integrity and weight: every artifact carrying a deciding fact - EV-TRIP-02739, EV-GPS-02739, EV-CHAT-02739 and EV-FARE-02739 - is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The fare line of SGD 4.50 reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, satisfying POL-NS-08(d), and the trace has 100 percent coverage with no gaps. The one impaired artifact, the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02739-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), carries no deciding fact: its absence merely makes the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation route unavailable and unnecessary.

Outcome: the disputed charge stands (POL-GEN-03's NO_ACTION disposition for the fee) and the driver is compensated, so the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60. The monetary effect is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold of POL-GEN-05. No referral fires: the arrival marker is genuine (dwell start offset 0.0 seconds, minimum recorded distance 0.11 m, no 15 km/h motion), so POL-NS-05(ii) has no false-arrival event to record, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming branch does not trip.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 is the anchor clause on which this 4.50 was charged, and it is drafted conjunctively: limb (d) requires the trip_record to show the trip terminated by the DRIVER under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The platform's own record shows the opposite. EV-TRIP-02739 carries cancelled_by 'RIDER', cancellation_reason_code 'RIDER_CANCELLED' and status 'CANCELLED_BY_RIDER', and its only trip_cancelled event at 15:20:31 is attributed to the rider, with no driver termination anywhere in the event list. The rider's account that she cancelled and the driver did not is therefore not a contested assertion about facts - it is what the platform's own telemetry records, and limb (d) fails on the face of the record.

No artifact in this bundle records any driver-side no-show step: EV-TRIP-02739 holds no driver termination, no unreachable-rider report, no excessive-wait report and no in-app call, and EV-CHAT-02739 holds only the driver's 'im at the pickup' at 15:14:36 and the rider's own 'sorry cant make it, cancelling' at 15:18:16. The counterparty's statement that 'she cancelled' is consistent with a rider cancellation and establishes nothing on the driver-termination limb that POL-NS-01(d) requires. The precondition for charging this sum as a no-show fee is thus absent from the evidence, and the rider asks the Judge to decide on the two records rather than on either party's description of them.

POL-NS-01 provides that where any of its limbs fails the fee 'is not chargeable under this clause'. The rider's remedy is confined to the single line that was charged - the 4.50 cancellation_fee in EV-FARE-02739, that being the whole contested amount, with no waiting-time fee charged (that line reads 0.00) and no other fare component in issue. The rider does not press grounds the timings in EV-TRIP-02739 do not support: the cancellation at 15:20:31 came well after the 180 second post-match grace, and no waiting-period shortfall is alleged. The rider asks that the contested 4.50 be returned in full on the reason-code ground above, which is the whole of the relief sought.

The trip record fixes the sequence without ambiguity: driver assigned 15:09:24, driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 15:14:06, the platform started the free waiting timer at 15:14:08, and the rider cancelled at 15:20:31 - six minutes and twenty-five seconds after the driver arrived and 385 seconds after the waiting clock began, against a free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, read with POL-NS-01(c) and the fee_schedule.resolution_rule). The driver did everything the platform asks of him before the rider pulled the trip.

The driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for one continuous qualifying run of 39 fixes lasting 382 seconds, from 15:14:06 to 15:20:28, per derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run. The derived shortfall against the minimum dwell is -202 seconds, i.e. he exceeded the 180 second free waiting period in force by more than a factor of two; the run clears even the 300 second pre-version-2 STANDARD figure, so the outcome does not depend on which figure is used.

The arrival marker is genuine, so the waiting clock runs from 15:14:06 and is not defeated by POL-NS-05. The derived dwell start offset is 0.0 seconds - the first qualifying in-geofence fix coincides with the tapped arrival - and the driver's recorded minimum distance from the pin is 0.11 m with a stationary speed reading, nowhere near POL-NS-05's 300 m or 15 km/h triggers. There is no false-arrival event to record against this driver.

The rider cancelled this trip in her own right, after the driver had arrived and after the in-geofence dwell had already run past the free waiting period. That is exactly the case POL-NS-10(g) governs: the fee stands at platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd as if the trip had been terminated by the driver for a no-show, and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout. The rider's stated ground - 'I cancelled myself, the driver did not cancel' - is therefore not a defence to the charge but the very fact that triggers it.

Independently of the no-show route, POL-NS-10(f) makes a rider's own cancellation after the grace chargeable: the cancellation came 667 seconds after accepted_at, far beyond the 180 second grace_after_match_sec, and none of the four exculpatory exceptions is on the record. Limb (c) is moreover affirmatively failed, not merely undecidable: the rider's own track holds 59 fixes whose distance from the pin runs from 764.6 m to 771.3 m (mean 767.9 m), every one of them far outside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, with rider_qualifying_fix_count 0. POL-NS-11 has no application because the rider track is present and runnable.

The driver put the rider on notice and the rider read it. The driver's message 'im at the pickup' was sent at 15:14:36 and read at 15:14:56, and the rider then waited nearly four more minutes before cancelling. A rider who is at the pin and trying to be collected does not read 'im at the pickup' and respond four minutes later with a cancellation; the chat corroborates that the fee is being disputed after the fact, not that the pickup failed.
